about: Tripo-generated models (ADR 0011). Each model has a brief (prompts, negative prompt, seeds, options), which `npm run tripo -- generate <name>` turns into candidates, one per prompt and seed. Use a paid key only: free-tier outputs are public and CC BY. Prompts describe features, never franchise, character, or trademark names (CLAUDE.md).

fighter.role: proposed: a sparring opponent beside or in place of the Training Dummy
